notes.title: Bots & Mods: Game Overhaul & Demo
notes.content: [p]Hi all,[/p][p]It's been a while. Last year, I took a break from [b]Bots & Mods[/b] to create my first released game, Book Bound. [/p][p]After the release, I returned to this game and didn't like some elements that were in it and worked on a big overhaul. The previous iteration of the game had automation elements, but I just felt like it didn't belong in this game. Customer interactions were also not the way I wanted them anymore. Previously, random characters would come and buy random items (or based on some artificial market), but I wanted more story and dialogue.[/p][p]I yanked a couple of things out and added some new stuff.[/p][p]Now, the game looks the way I wanted it to be. You will still take over a robot workshop and do a whole bunch of crafting and gathering, but also meet and interact with a bunch of characters. There is also an overall story that you'll follow.[/p][p][/p][h2]THE DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]I hope you guys will give it a go.[/p][p]Thanks[/p][p]bit66[/p][p][/p]
